package private

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/task"
)

type diagnosticRouterLessons struct{}

func (diagnosticRouterLessons) ListByCourse(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	return []domain.Lesson{{ID: "lesson", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive}}, nil
}

type diagnosticRouterTasks struct{}

func (diagnosticRouterTasks) ListByLesson(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Task, error) {
	return []domain.Task{{ID: "task", Type: domain.TaskTypeTest, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto, Version: 1}}, nil
}

func TestNewPrivateRouterRegistersDiagnosticCatalogWithAuth(t *testing.T) {
	handler := &handlers.TaskHandler{GetInternalCourseStructureUC: task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: diagnosticRouterLessons{}, Tasks: diagnosticRouterTasks{}}}
	router := NewRouter(handler, nil, nil, nil, "internal-token", "planner-token", "diagnostic-token")
	for name, token := range map[string]string{"missing": "", "general internal": "internal-token", "planner write": "planner-token", "wrong": "wrong", "correct": "diagnostic-token"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/course/get-internal-diagnostic-assessments/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", nil)
			if token != "" {
				req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
			}
			resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)
			want := http.StatusForbidden
			if name == "correct" {
				want = http.StatusOK
			}
			if resp.Code != want {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d", resp.Code, want)
			}
		})
	}
}
